Class MistralModel

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.provider.AbstractModel
uno.anahata.asi.openai.compatible.OpenAiCompatibleModel
uno.anahata.asi.mistral.MistralModel
public class MistralModel extends OpenAiCompatibleModel
A specialized model implementation for Mistral AI that parses capability flags, max context length, FIM (Fill-In-The-Middle), and reasoning configurations from Mistral's /v1/models JSON.
